For question results, I should pull the title from details and check isError before processing dependencies, and for the saved fallback I need a sensible priority order since dependency extraction alone won't give me a name.

For the function name fallback, a lightweight regex can pull the name from a function declaration when present, and the title should fall back through label, first line of code, functionId, then finally "typescript". I also need to handle edge cases like empty code splitting cleanly, and I'm planning out the test coverage needed: blank titles, save-only paths with and without a saved function, missing details, non-string code, question results, and empty-content error cases, some of which will need synthetic constructed results since they represent host-supplied data rather than live tool calls.
